remaining_nonexactness_classes.detail: the vendored vc2008rtm cl 15.00.21022 never emits __imp_?c_str@... (it inlines VS9 _String_val::_Myptr), while the original exe imports c_str at IAT 0x802464 and calls it from 110 functions. Caps CRobloxTreeCtrlNode::onGetDispInfo 00425320, CMemberTreeView::addFunction 00435680, CDeclarationView::setContent 00434020 + showDescriptor 00435860, CScriptEditor::reload 00465550, CRobloxDHtmlDialog::OnInitDialog 0044efd0.
remaining_nonexactness_classes.build_test: closed negative: isolated probes compiled with all three vendored builds (vc2008rtm 21022, vc2008sp1/Microsoft Visual C++ for Python 30729, vc2005/VS8 50727) under /O2 /EHsc /MD all inline c_str - none emits __imp_?c_str@... So this is not a build-selection difference; the original build's dllimport-class flavour for inline std::string members cannot be reproduced with the vendored toolchain. Owner: treat as a known toolchain limitation (or supply the original build's headers/compiler), not as a per-source flag choice.

remaining_nonexactness_classes.detail: the exe contains two same-symbol copies and the linker keeps different call bindings per TU; our object's byte/relocation comparison passes but the address-level call identity is undecidable from the object alone.
